dedupe_keys.name: sample gtfs feed imaginary gtfs schedule dataset for testing

description: sample-gtfs-feed is an imaginary GTFS Schedule dataset for testing software. It forms a feed for a simple fictional transit network using the agency, stops, routes, trips, stop_times, calendar, calendar_dates, frequencies, transfers, pathways, levels and feed_info tables, so developers can exercise most parts of the standard, including pathways inside stations. The npm package holds plain CSV files that can be processed like any GTFS feed. Coverage: a fictional network. Format and access: GTFS CSV files in a public repository and on npm. Licence and cost: a permissive ISC-style licence (copyright 2024, Jannis R), free. Caveats: synthetic and small, so it tests software, not represents any real service. It supports network flow model development as a test case for parsers and routers. It relates to the GTFS specification and the canonical GTFS validator in the catalogue.
